title: Surcharge Percentage Set by a Guest's Driving Record, Keyturn Guest Protection Plan
content:
The surcharge percentage follows how the guest has actually driven. It is read from the guest's own trip
ledger on the Keyturn Trip Booking, in which lateness appears as a late return charged and a mileage overage as
a mileage overage charged.

- Where the guest's trips carry no late return charged over the last twelve months and no mileage overage
  charged in that time, the percentage is 14.0 percent.
- Where the guest's trips carry no late return charged over the last twelve months and one or more mileage
  overages charged in that time, the percentage is 17.5 percent.
- Where the guest's trips carry one or more late returns charged over the last twelve months, the level's own
  protection surcharge percentage applies, whatever the mileage overages show.

The level's own protection surcharge percentages are 0 on Keyturn Declined Protection, 25 on Keyturn Minimum
Protection, 22 on Keyturn Standard Protection, 18 on Keyturn Advantage Protection, 15 on Keyturn Premier
Protection and 12 on Keyturn Business Traveler Protection.

## The combinations in full

| Late returns charged in the last twelve months | Mileage overages charged in that time | Percentage taken |
|---|---|---|
| None | None | 14.0 percent |
| None | One or more | 17.5 percent |
| One or more | None | The level's own protection surcharge percentage |
| One or more | One or more | The level's own protection surcharge percentage |

## Worked on hypothetical ledgers

A guest whose trips over the last twelve months carry no late return and no mileage overage is charged at 14.0
percent whatever level the election stands on. The same guest with one mileage overage charged in that period
is charged at 17.5 percent. A guest with one late return charged in that period, on an election standing on
Keyturn Advantage Protection, is charged at that level's own percentage of 18, which stands above both of the
other two rates; on Keyturn Business Traveler Protection the same guest is charged at 12, which stands below
them.
